# Papyrus

> Papyrus is an open-source document reader SDK for web and mobile, with shared contracts, pluggable engines, and React and React Native UI packages.

Papyrus supports document-reader workflows rather than rendering alone: page navigation, thumbnails, text selection, search, themes, and annotations.

## Start here

- [Demo](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/demo): Try the interactive browser demo.
- [Quickstart](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/quickstart): Install and render a document.
- [Architecture](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/architecture): Understand the core, engine, and UI layers.
- [Configuration](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/configuration): Configure themes, navigation, engines, and viewer options.
- [Comparisons](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/comparisons): Compare architectural capabilities and evaluation criteria.

## Documentation

- [Interactive examples](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/examples/): Explore themes, locale, events, and engine switching.
- [Mobile](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/mobile): Integrate the React Native and native engine layers.
- [Core flows](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/flows): Follow loading, rendering, search, and event flows.
- [Open Source PDF SDK](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/open-source-pdf-sdk): Evaluate Papyrus as an open-source PDF SDK.
- [Open Source EPUB SDK](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/open-source-epub-sdk): Understand the EPUB integration.
- [Papyrus vs PDFTron / Apryse](https://solrachix.github.io/Papyrus/papyrus-pdftron-alternative): Read the existing comparison.

## Packages

- [@papyrus-sdk/types](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@papyrus-sdk/types): Shared engine, annotation, and event contracts.
- [@papyrus-sdk/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@papyrus-sdk/core): Shared viewer state and events.
- [@papyrus-sdk/ui-react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@papyrus-sdk/ui-react): React viewer, topbar, sidebars, search, and annotations.
- [@papyrus-sdk/ui-react-native](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@papyrus-sdk/ui-react-native): React Native reader UI.
- [@papyrus-sdk/engine-pdfjs](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@papyrus-sdk/engine-pdfjs): Web PDF engine based on PDF.js.
- [@papyrus-sdk/engine-native](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@papyrus-sdk/engine-native): Native iOS and Android engine bridge.

## Supported document flows

- PDF on web and native platforms.
- EPUB and TXT through the shared reader contracts.
- CBZ through ZIP-based browser engines, including an experimental Rust/WASM engine.
- CBR through the browser archive flow where the required RAR support is available.
